question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

If you do not return my money, I will ______ you to court.
solution:
The correct answer is "drag".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence 'If you do not return my money, I will ______ you to court." needs an appropriate word from the given options to be filled in the blank.
 
• The person is saying to another person that if he does not return his money back then he will take him to the court.
 
• The marked option **Drag**: means to make somebody come or go somewhere.
 
 
• **Example:** You can come with me quietly, or I can drag you out of here. 
 
 
 
• From the given example and the meaning of the marked option, we are clear that** 'drag'** is the appropriate word to be filled in the blank.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 4.**
